target_evaluation.embedding: frozen 768-D backbone output from selected 7-label CE model
target_evaluation.prototype: per-class mean from target train only
target_evaluation.mahalanobis: shared pooled within-class covariance from target-train residuals, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage; target valid/test excluded from fitting

caveats: This is supervised target-gallery metric evaluation, not zero-shot: labeled target train images define means and covariance.
Five exact image hashes overlap target train and target test, so the target split is not strictly duplicate-free unseen evaluation.
This fresh local 30-epoch run is not the unavailable historical internal-network checkpoint and is not directly comparable as a controlled rerun.
